changes: Starting a new checkout while you already have a subscription now says so, instead of telling you to resubscribe
Check waiting recordings and show completed sync results when Omi reopens, without requiring another upload first
A voice sample on a person's page shows Play again once it finishes, instead of a pause button for audio that already stopped.

changes.change: Apple Watch now shows a clear Stop recording button and releases the microphone when recording stops or startup is cancelled.

changes: Reduced background work while recordings sync and live indicators animate
Smoother scrolling through long transcripts and conversation photos.
With debug logs on, Omi records which screens stutter so a shared log shows where the app is slow
Home does less work while scrolling long conversation histories and when another tab is open

changes.change: Scrolling and tapping are smoother because Omi no longer builds an accessibility tree on every frame when no assistive feature is on

changes: VoiceOver and TalkBack no longer re-announce Home's live conversation row every second
Tasks stays responsive with long lists, and Chat does less work while replies stream.
Catching up no longer shows a decades-old start date when a recording was made before the wearable's clock was ever set
Scrolling further down your conversations and opening a long conversation no longer pause the app while the next page loads
Improved responsiveness when browsing long task lists and loading app chat history.
